flagged.evidence: The step states: “Because $D_X(\overline h_i)\subseteq D_X(\overline f)$, every point of $X$ at which $h_i$ vanishes also makes $f$ vanish. Equivalently, $V(I(X)+(h_i))\subseteq V(I(X)+(f))$.” The implication has the containment direction reversed. For $X=\mathbf A_k^1$, $\overline f=\overline t$, and $\overline h=\overline{t(t-1)}$, one has $D_X(\overline h)\subseteq D_X(\overline f)$, but at $t=1$, $h=0$ and $f=1$, so $V((h))\nsubseteq V((f))$. Thus the cited Nullstellensatz cannot yield $f\in\sqrt{I(X)+(h_i)}$ or $\overline f^{N_i}=\overline c_i\overline h_i$. The invalid relation is then used to form the common-denominator expressions $a_i/\overline f^N$ required for the surjectivity proof.
